title: John Bogle
html: Who: Founded Vanguard and launched the first retail index fund (1976). The intellectual father of funds like SPY. Core ideas: Costs compound against you; most active managers trail the index after fees; buy the whole market and hold it. Read: The Little Book of Common Sense Investing. For our plan: SPY is a Bogle-style core. Keep fees low, contribute regularly, don't trade around headlines. Back to Council of Masters
